description: This file contains the PHP class 'Order' in the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account'. It defines methods for retrieving order data, handling order-related queries such as fetching specific orders, order lists, products, options, subscription details, vouchers, totals, histories, and counts. The class extends a base model class and interacts extensively with the database to manage order information for an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents the Order model in the catalog's account namespace, providing methods to access and manage order-related data such as order details, products, options, subscriptions, vouchers, history, and counts.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific order by its ID, including customer and shipping details, country and zone codes, and order metadata.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Provides a list of orders for the current customer, supporting pagination with start and limit parameters.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific product within an order identified by the order ID and order product ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves all options for a specific order product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Returns subscription details associated with a specific order product.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Fetches all vouchers linked to a specific order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves total calculations related to a specific order.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Gets the status change history of a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts the total number of history entries for an order.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProductId
methods.description: Get total number of orders containing a specific product ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByOrderId
methods.description: Get total number of products in a specific order by order ID.

methods.name: getTotalVouchersByOrderId
methods.description: Get total number of vouchers linked to a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Get total number of orders linked to a specific subscription ID for the current customer.
